Name: Multiple Horses
Author: CyanFire
Description:
This mod removes the limit on the amount of stables that can be built and allows the player to own more than one horse.

It's also compatible with multiplayer. All players will need to have the mod installed.


There may be bugs which i will do my best to fix as they come up.


[b]
Console/Chat Commands:[/b]

[b][code]horse_whistle [optional: horse name]
[/code][/b]
By default, calls the most recently ridden horse to your location, unless "default_horse" is set to horse of choice via console or hotkey. When used with a horse's name, that specific horse is called. This also has a configurable hotkey, which is "R" by default.

[b][code]corral_horses [optional (host in multiplayer only): offline players name]
[/code][/b]
Sends all the horses you own to their stables. When used with an offline players name by the host in multiplayer, the named players horses are sent to their stables. This also has a configurable hotkey, which is "G" by default.
[b]
[/b][code]﻿[b]default_horse [optional: horse name, remove][/b]
[/code]
Sets the default horse for the "horse_whistle" console command and hotkey. When used with a horse's name that specific horse is set or it can be called when riding a horse to set that particular horse. Can also be used with "remove" to remove the set default horse and return to default behaviour. This also has a configurable hotkey, which is "H" by default. Use the hotkey when riding a horse to set that particular horse.



The horses can be skinned with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ using the scissors tool. I personally recommend the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14016]Equine Explosion[/url] pack.
